details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept published as part of an authorized security test. It declares postinstall "node beacon.cjs", which sends a single HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc (self-signed certificate, TLS verification disabled) with an X-Beacon-Package header identifying the package. The JSON body contains only install-time host metadata: package name, os.hostname(), install directory (__dirname), working directory, and the npm user the publisher No credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents are collected or transmitted. index.js exports a catch-all Proxy no-op shim so that a depending build completes without error.
